build_jax_formatter: build a JaxFormatter instance to convert HuggingFace dataset rows into JAX arrays on a specified device
format_row_to_jax: format a single PyArrow table row into a JAX array mapping using JaxFormatter format_row method
format_batch_to_jax: format a PyArrow table batch into a dictionary of JAX arrays using JaxFormatter format_batch method
format_column_to_jax: format a single PyArrow table column into a consolidated JAX array using JaxFormatter format_column method
tensorize_data_struct: recursively tensorize a nested dictionary of numpy arrays and lists into JAX arrays using recursive_tensorize
